resources.name: Elk all-electron DFT code (or FLEUR)

access.notes: Open-source all-electron full-potential linearized augmented plane-wave (FP-LAPW) code; alternative: FLEUR (https://www.flapw.de).

resources.notes: Any all-electron DFT code that can handle relativistic effects (scalar-relativistic and fully relativistic including spin-orbit coupling) is acceptable.

resources.name: hcp lutetium crystal structure parameters

access.notes: Typical lattice constants: a=3.503 Å, c=5.551 Å (space group P6₃/mmc). Available from standard materials databases or literature.

resources.notes: Used to set up the hcp crystal structure in the DFT calculation.

resources.name: Lutetium atomic electronic configuration (5d¹ 6s²)

access.notes: Lu atomic configuration: [Xe]4f14 5d1 6s2. Standard reference data.

resources.notes: Used to define the atomic reference configuration for constructing the crystal potential.
